metrics.profile_summary: Versatile professional with a strong academic foundation in Marketing and extensive experience in Software Quality Assurance and customer relationship management. Expert in SQA leadership, Salesforce automation, and digital banking operations.

experience.description: Developed test strategies for Salesforce and mobile apps, reducing post-release defects by 30% and managing client requirements.
Conducted root cause analysis on defects and mentored junior QA members to enhance product quality.
Managed digital account opening and directed digital marketing strategies to improve client experience and growth.
Managed 100+ enterprise accounts as a relationship manager, achieving 100% KPI fulfillment.
Led mobile app and internet banking upgrades, improving app store ratings and customer satisfaction.
Utilized social media for skip tracing and portfolio analysis to improve recovery rates.

strengths: Perfect educational alignment with BBA and MBA in Marketing
Strong background in digital customer experience
weaknesses: Recent professional experience is focused on SQA/Technical QA rather than Marketing
No evidence of experience with Meta Business Suite, Canva, or social media scheduling
Lacks a portfolio of content creation or campaign management
evaluation.summary: Despite having the ideal educational background in Marketing, the candidate has spent the last several years building a career in Software Quality Assurance. They lack the specific hands-on experience in social media management and content coordination required for this role.
